---
name: Feature Request
about: Suggest a new feature or improvement
title: "[FEATURE] "
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''
---

**What would you like?**
A clear description of the feature or improvement.

**Why is this useful?**
What problem does this solve? Who benefits from it?

**How would you use it?**
Example usage or workflow.

**Alternatives considered**
Any other ways you thought about solving this.

**Additional context**
Anything else — links, screenshots, prior art, etc.
